system.description: Lightning crackles across your body until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery. The electricity doesn't harm you, but it automatically inflicts 3 damage on anyone who tries to touch you or strike you with a melee attack (no roll required). While this ability is active, you ignore moderate and minor wounds from electricity. While this ability is active, you can make a touch attack that inflicts 2 damage from electricity. Enabler.
